facts: The organizers asked for the government funding pathway for Soundings (response drafted by the owner; notice text pending verbatim capture).
Navy SBIR topics N152-113, N252-116 and N252-117 exist and address harbor UUV detection and the steps after a UUV is determined unauthorized.
DHS S&T funds maritime port security research; the Coast Guard Captain of the Port sets harbor security zones.
